articles.summary: A sandbox for AI runs: every agent task gets its own FlashVM. It's claimed warm in milliseconds, runs whatever the agent wrote behind a real hypervisor boundary, and is thrown away when the task ends. One install, no account, no cloud. articles.title: Stop building new AI agent orchestrators – there are 636
articles.summary: Before you write another orchestrator, check whether someone already has. This repo indexes 633 open-source and source-available tools that run, supervise, or coordinate AI agents: parallel coding agents, multi-agent swarms, loop and task runners, infrastructure, and personal assistants. 449 of them had a commit in the last 30 days. articles.title: Misaligned AI behaviors that indicate loss-of-control risk
articles.summary: Ten kinds of AI misbehavior that developers should monitor, investigate, and report. A fundamental driver of loss-of-control risk is misalignment, wherein an AI system does not reliably try to behave as its developers intend. So far, warning signs of misalignment have often been observable in what AI systems think and do. This post lays out ten kinds of AI misbehavior that are warning signs of misalignment and loss-of-control risk. articles.summary: We’re officially skill-pilled. PostHog teams have published 226 skills to our internal skill store , and we have 187 SKILL.md files across 28 different products in our codebase.
